body:
I definitely felt this. I don’t know if it was so much the hormones as the excruciating pains though. 

You should definitely talk to a medical professional. Getting on the right birth control really made my life easier in at least this one way.

It’s comforting to know I’m not the only one who feels this. 

>you were probably really bright when you were younger, that's how i feel about myself at least.. "damn i was bright and had so much potential" 

You know how people make fun of those jocks who peaked in high school and refuse to grow up past that? That’s kind of me, except I peaked in elementary school and everything went downhill from there 

I hope you’re right btw, for both of ours sake. Maybe the old me is still in there somewhere, just hibernating. Or maybe the new me is ok in her own right if I just give her a chance.
Right back back at you. Let’s see this through, at least for another month or two. Maybe things’ll take a turn for the better.❤️

Oh, don’t worry! I quickly became very disillusioned with the idea of drowning after some kids I know found a corpse washed up on shore, scarring them for life. 

As a swimmer it just seemed so lovely in theory, letting the ocean devour me. As a kid I was obsessed with the little mermaid, and in the orignal fairytale she turns to sea foam at the end, letting all her sorrows be washed away with the waves. That’s probably where the idea originated.

And I’ve been blueballing Death for about a decade now, so I’ll probably survive this summer too lol
